# Coere

> Coere (Coere AI) is the memory layer for AI. Coere is not Cohere: the name comes from the Latin cohaerere, "to connect". Website: https://www.coere.ai/

Coere carries a person's memory across every AI they use, so a new chat in any of them picks up where the last one left off.

## Products

- Coere Connect: a Chrome extension that carries your memory across every AI you use, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, Copilot, Meta AI, Kimi and DeepSeek. Install it once, and a new chat in any of them picks up where the last one left off.
- Coere Developer: developers can read the memory layer through the API, MCP or SDK, making every user known on day one.
